negative_prompt: lettering, captions, signatures, watermarks, decorative borders

references.role: architectural shapes, density and monumental scale

review_criteria.description: Small desiccated remains in the middle distance, pierced through the chest by a grounded side-spur; the architecture remains the main subject.
Dense, angular, tapered manufactured thorns match the architectural reference; avoid isolated obelisks and organic trees.
Painterly grimdark digital concept art with deliberate silhouettes, restrained palette and atmospheric depth.
Assess composition, lighting, shape design, brushwork, visual hierarchy and storytelling separately from detail or resolution.
Convincing supported geometry, gravity and anatomy without unrelated objects, duplicated forms or unwanted lettering.
